Corridor `bridge` on level `upper` connects `hall`, which is on level `ground`. A corridor stays on one level; join levels with a connection of type stairs, ladder or trapdoor.
A `level` holds rooms and corridors, but found `feature`. Connections, notes and exports go in the `dungeon` block; features and entities go inside their room.
The room `garden` is outside the `level` blocks. A dungeon with levels keeps every room and corridor inside one; move it into a level, for example `ground`.
